r.name: Reigate Hill Walk, Harewoods
r.description: Enjoy an exhilarating walk across Reigate Hill and learn how man has influenced the history on the hill. Steep descent on chalk path. Steps present. Potential livestock present.

r.name: Reigate Hill From the Train Station Walk, Harewoods
r.description: This vigorous climb up the chalk escarpment will reward you with memorable views. From the top, clamber down the hillside on a gentle stroll back along the bottom of the Downs, learning Reigate's mining history. Mostly surfaced with steep ascent & descent

r.name: Margery Wood Circular Walk, Harewoods
r.description: Enjoy this scenic walk at Reigate Hill. The chalk downland on this stretch of the North Downs boasts rare flora and fauna and some of the most magnificent views of the Surrey Hills towards the South Downs. Steep ascents & descents & undulating paths.

r.name: Margery Wood, Walton Heath and Colley Hill Walk, Harewoods
r.description: Margery Woods in Surrey is a lovely spot to walk whatever the season. It's great for bluebells in spring and lovely in autumn as the leaves turn golden brown. Colley Hill boasts magnificent views over Surrey to the South Downs. Flat but muddy in places.

r.name: Gatton Park Past and Present Walk, Harewoods
r.description: Stroll through Gatton Park, designed by 'Capability' Brown & enjoy its diverse history. With serpentine lakes & tree islands, explore all year round, but particularly in winter & during bluebell season. Steep gradients & rough stoney paths

r.name: A suburban oasis: Morden Hall Park walk, Morden
r.description: Enjoy an easy stroll through this historic parkland created by the Hatfeild family in the 19th century & experience inspiring verdant surroundings in the heart of South London. Free Admission. Reasonably flat terrain; muddy in wet weather. Wheel friendly.
